svg.title: Mert Efe Şensoy's project connectome
svg.desc: A soma labelled mertefe integrates a membrane potential, crosses threshold and fires one spike along six axons. Each spike lights a project node with its brand mark and an honest status line: FlyBatch (v0.5.1-rc.1 · TESTERS: 501-neuron fly circuit; identical fingerprints, x86-64 to MVS); SuperconducTED (RESEARCH PREVIEW: Noise as a range, not a number: IT2 fuzzy noise for Qiskit Aer); Cassandra Collective (STAGE 0 · NEGATIVE: Everyday-hardware language models: CASSANDRA, Chorus, Dervish); Open Memory Initiative (ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT: Open, reproducible DDR4 UDIMM reference design and tooling); spdr (v0.1.1 · crates.io: DDR5 SPD decoder and beyond-CRC linter: no_std, no panic); Ephesus (PRE-ALPHA: An agent company you govern as its architect, built in public).

g.text: 501-neuron fly circuit; identical fingerprints, x86-64 to MVS
No IBM Z hardware yet: MVS 3.8j under Hercules, s390x under QEMU
Noise as a range, not a number: IT2 fuzzy noise for Qiskit Aer
Cycle 1 pipeline validated; trained memberships are cycle 2
Everyday-hardware language models: CASSANDRA, Chorus, Dervish
Chorus Stage 0 closed as a published negative result; replanning
Open, reproducible DDR4 UDIMM reference design and tooling
Schematic-stage work; claims never run ahead of validation
DDR5 SPD decoder and beyond-CRC linter: no_std, no panic
UDIMM complete; SODIMM, RDIMM, LRDIMM wait for real fixtures
An agent company you govern as its architect, built in public
No releases and no installer; everything runs from source today
